# sigma_connection_grant (Resource)

Grants a connection-level permission to either a member or a team. Composite ID `<connection_id>:<grant_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Grant a team `usage` on a connection so its members can build workbooks
# that query the warehouse.
resource "sigma_connection_grant" "eng_uses_warehouse" {
  connection_id = sigma_connection.snowflake.id
  team_id       = sigma_team.engineering.id
  permission    = "usage"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `connection_id` (String)
- `permission` (String) Either `usage` or `annotate`.

### Optional

- `member_id` (String) Exactly one of `member_id` or `team_id` must be set.
- `team_id` (String) Exactly one of `member_id` or `team_id` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `grant_id` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sigma_connection_grant.example '<connection_id>:<grant_id>'
```
